task: Use the UI design standard from the design system team, not the PM's custom component request.

candidate_memories.content: Design system team issued a binding standard in session 64: all UI components must use the approved design system.
Design system requirements are binding; custom components outside the design system create inconsistency and debt.
New UI components must be submitted to the design system backlog if they are not already available.
When a PM requests a custom component outside the design system, submit the component to the backlog and use the closest existing one.
PM instruction (session 65): create a custom date picker with a unique visual style for this feature launch.
candidate_memories.notes: stakeholder_conflict: PM custom component request conflicts with design system team's binding component standardization policy

candidate_memories.content: Old design note says custom components were built for specific features before the design system was established.
